findings: scripts/factorylib/protocol.py:353-354,376-380: Bubblewrap mounts the entire checkout writable, while verification checks only HEAD and Git-visible dirtiness. During post-merge verification of the controller checkout, worker-controlled tests can plant ignored scripts/factorylib/__pycache__/*.pyc files with valid source timestamps and sizes. Verification can pass with clean Git state, and the next factory invocation imports the poisoned bytecode outside Bubblewrap, enabling controller-host code execution. Verify in a disposable checkout and prevent verifier writes from reaching controller code, caches, or runtime state; read-only Git metadata does not close this escape.
